heroDescription: One restricted credit balance you can use at participating restaurants under their current partner agreements.
disclaimerTitle: Stored-value credit, not a bank account
disclaimerBody: OxSteed Credit is not a deposit account, cash balance, or promise of bank services. Spending is limited to the partners and terms shown below.
pausedBody: Your balance and history remain available. New Credit spending is paused while the network is being reviewed.
guardrailsCopy: These limits help protect your restricted balance. Reservations count toward spending until they are captured, released, or expired.
authorizeCopy: Choose a participating restaurant and reserve the exact amount. The cashier can capture it once, and the hold expires automatically if it is not used.
holdIdInstruction: Give this hold ID to the cashier
holdDetails: It is for {{amount}} and expires {{date}}. Never share your account password.
holdsCopy: Active reservations reduce your spendable balance until captured, released, or expired. Completed reservations stay here so you can reconcile every temporary balance change.
cancelAuthorizationCopy: Cancel an authorization if you will not use it. This immediately returns the reserved amount to your spendable balance.
partnerNetworkCopy: Only active restaurants with a current agreement appear here. The list is the source of truth for where your balance can be used today.
partnerHidden: Partner restaurants are hidden until your OxSteed Credit account is active. Contact support if you need help.
creditBecomesSpendable: OxSteed Credit becomes spendable as participating restaurants are activated.
tryAnother: Try another restaurant, city, or order type.
termsFallback: Use is subject to the active partner agreement and restaurant terms.
statementCopy: Every balance change is recorded in the OxSteed Credit ledger with a timestamp and transaction type. Showing {{from}} through {{to}}.
activityCopy: Your credit activity will appear here when a load, purchase, transfer, or refund is posted.
disputeCopy: This creates a review record without changing your balance automatically. If the connection drops, submitting the same form again is safe.
disputesCopy: Disputes are reviewed separately from your balance. A status change never edits the original ledger entry.
transactionDescription: Review the posted details for this OxSteed Credit balance change. Your access is limited to your own account activity.
incorrectEntryCopy: If this entry looks incorrect or you do not recognize it, report it from your Credit activity list. A dispute creates a review record without changing your balance automatically.
errorLoad: Unable to load OxSteed Credit right now.
chooseEligibleAmount: Choose an eligible restaurant and enter a valid amount.
authorizationCreated: Authorization created. Give the hold ID to the cashier.
conversionCopy: Use an approved, unexpired quote. OxSteed never estimates exchange rates or combines currencies automatically.
conversionQuoteRequired: Enter a valid quote ID and source amount.
conversionQuoteMismatch: The quote is expired, unavailable, or does not match this currency and amount.
holdIdCopyError: Unable to copy the hold ID.
disputeSubmitted: Your dispute was submitted for review.
partnerActivityDescription: Review restricted-credit purchases and settlement records for this restaurant. Customer identity stays private.
noPartnerActivity: No OxSteed Credit activity has posted for this restaurant.
noSettlementRecords: No settlement records have been created yet.
partnerActivityError: OxSteed Credit partner activity could not be loaded.
partnerReportError: OxSteed Credit report could not be downloaded.
adminPageDescription: Operate a restricted credit network: customers can spend only at restaurants with an active partner agreement, and every movement is journaled, bounded, and auditable.
adminCreditRailDescription: This gate controls new loads, holds, purchases, and transfers. Suspending it does not edit or delete ledger history, and every change is recorded in the Credit audit trail.
adminSuspendRailPlaceholder: Why are you suspending the rail?
adminEnableRailPlaceholder: Why are you enabling the rail?
adminNotEligibleForSpending: Not eligible for customer spending until coverage is active.
adminReviewRenewals: Review renewals before active coverage ends.
adminDeliveryContractDescription: Retries are bounded and duplicate events are prevented.
adminRetryOnlyRequeues: Retrying only requeues the notification. It does not reverse, duplicate, or edit any Credit transaction.
adminCustomerAccessDescription: Access is assigned per partner agreement. Keep the same customer ID and submit another agreement to authorize spending at multiple restaurants. This does not move balance or bypass the agreement's own rules.
adminUnableLoadAccess: Unable to load customer restaurant access.
adminAccessCsvDownloaded: Customer access CSV downloaded with the active filters.
adminUnableExportAccess: Unable to export customer restaurant access.
adminAccessAlreadyCurrent: That customer access record was already up to date.
adminBulkAccessCustomerAndReasonRequired: Customer UUID and a reason are required for bulk customer access.
adminBulkAccessAgreementRequired: Select at least one restaurant agreement for bulk customer access.
adminBulkAccessAlreadyApplied: That bulk customer access action was already applied.
adminBulkAccessSaved: Customer access saved across {{count}} restaurant agreements.
adminBulkAccessFailed: Bulk customer access update failed. No partial changes were saved.
adminBulkAccessCurrencyMismatch: Selected agreements use different currencies. Clear the limits or select agreements sharing one currency.
adminInvalidLimitAmount: Enter a valid positive amount in {{currency}}, or leave the limit blank.
adminCustomerUuidPlaceholder: Paste UUID or choose from loaded wallets
adminAgreementSearchHelp: Use Find agreements to search beyond the initial agreement list.
adminAuthorizeMultipleRestaurants: Authorize the same customer at multiple restaurants
adminUnableLoadRestaurantLedger: Unable to load the restaurant Credit ledger.
adminReserveFundedNotice: Restaurant reserve funded and recorded in the immutable Credit ledger.
adminReserveReleasedNotice: Restaurant reserve release recorded in the immutable Credit ledger.
adminRestaurantLedgerDescription: Each restaurant has its own payable account and protected reserve account. Funding records are immutable and require a reason, idempotency key, and external reference; this does not claim that a bank transfer occurred outside the system.
adminReserveMovementDescription: Funding moves value from the central treasury account into this restaurant reserve. Release reverses that movement. It cannot directly change restaurant payable earnings.
adminReserveReasonPlaceholder: Why is this reserve movement authorized?
adminWorkerHealthDescription: Durable checkpoints cover delivery, reservations, lifecycle expiry, reconciliation, integrity verification, and restaurant wallet operations. A missing or failed checkpoint is operational evidence, not a ledger mutation.
adminSharedRedisDetail: Required for safe multi-instance locks and worker coordination.
adminDedicatedLedgerKeyDetail: Keeps ledger integrity separate from authentication secrets.
adminLedgerKeyConfigurationDetail: Current and previous key versions are configured for verification.
adminServerErrorMonitoringDetail: Required to detect production failures and trigger incident response.
adminProductionPrerequisitesDescription: These checks are safe signals only. Keep the Credit rail suspended until infrastructure, custody, compliance, and the production runbook have also been approved.
adminNoRefundableBalance: No refundable balance remains for this purchase. Posted refunds:
adminRefundDescription: Post a partial or full immutable refund. The server rejects refunds above the remaining refundable purchase amount.
adminRefundReasonPlaceholder: Customer cancellation, duplicate charge, or dispute outcome
adminCustomerProfileDescription: One read-only view of this customer wallet, all restaurant assignments, reserved funds, and ledger history. Assignment rows can cover multiple restaurants without combining their agreements or currencies.
adminUnableDownloadCustomerStatement: Unable to download this customer Credit statement.
adminUnableLoadCustomerProfile: Unable to load this customer Credit profile.
adminUnableLoadEligibility: Unable to load current restaurant eligibility.
adminEligibilityUnavailable: Current spend eligibility is unavailable. No access decision was made.
adminNoSpendableRestaurants: No restaurant is currently spendable for this customer and currency.
adminNoCustomerAssignments: No customer-specific assignments. Partner-wide agreements may still apply.
adminWhereCustomerCanSpend: Where this customer can spend now
adminEligibilityDescription: This is the same centrally enforced eligibility result used by checkout, including rail status, wallet state, active agreements, entitlements, currency, and restaurant status.
adminNoHolds: No holds recorded for this wallet.
adminReadOnlyUsageDescription: Read-only usage against the same daily spending and transfer caps enforced at checkout. The counters reset at {{date}}.
adminNoCustomerDisputes: No Credit disputes recorded for this customer.
adminNoLedgerActivity: No ledger activity for this wallet yet.
adminNoCustomerControls: No customer-specific Credit controls have been recorded.
adminReasonPlaceholder: Why this customer is eligible for this partner
adminNoAccessMatches: No customer restaurant access matches these filters.
adminSettlementEvidenceDescription: Keep the approval actor, external payment reference, and paid timestamp visible together so each partner payout can be reconciled without opening another screen.
adminRecentSettlementSummary: Showing the six most recent settlement records. Use the settlement queue filters and CSV export for the full history.
adminSearchControlTrailDetail: Filter the append-only control history before reviewing state changes. Results are bounded and can be loaded in older pages without downloading the entire ledger.
adminPartnerAgreementHealthDetail: These counts are calculated across the full partner network, not just the first page. Resolve coverage gaps before customers are told they can spend Credit at a restaurant.
adminCreditCustomerNotificationsDetail: Ledger changes commit independently from notification delivery. Use this view to catch delivery backlog or terminal failures without changing customer balances.
adminCreditTransactionHistoryDetail: Review the full platform movement stream with server-side filters. Amounts are immutable journal movements; open a customer wallet or audit trail for the surrounding context.
adminFundingSpendingTransferLimitsDetail: These server-side caps are enforced in the database transaction. Amounts use the selected overview currency; transfer controls apply only when customer-to-customer transfers are enabled.
adminPartnerEnrollmentDescription: Enrollment starts as Pending. Activate only after confirming commercial terms, settlement, and customer eligibility.
adminPartnerNetworkDescription: A partner must be Active and have an Active agreement before it appears in customer eligibility results.
adminPartnerEnrollmentCreated: Partner enrollment created in Pending status. Activate it after confirming the agreement.
adminEnrollmentReasonPlaceholder: Why is this restaurant being enrolled?
adminAgreementLifecycleDescription: Use lifecycle transitions instead of deleting agreements so the historical record remains intact.
adminSettlementQueueDescription: Filter settlement history without loading every record at once.
adminSettlementControlsDescription: Create a period snapshot, approve it only after review, and mark it paid only with a traceable external payment reference.
adminPaymentReferencePlaceholder: Bank transfer, payout, or processor reference
adminReasonForSnapshotPlaceholder: Why is this settlement snapshot being created?
adminReasonForReconciliationPlaceholder: Why is this ledger check being run?
adminReconciliationHistoryDescription: Every check is preserved as a separate operational record. Use the difference and entry counts to decide whether a settlement is safe to approve; no reconciliation action changes balances.
adminNoReconciliationRuns: No reconciliation runs match these filters.
adminDisputeQueueDescription: Disputes preserve the original journal transaction. Filter by lifecycle state and load older cases from the server; resolve with a documented outcome and use a separate compensating refund or adjustment rather than editing history.
adminAuditHistoryDescription: Every rail, partner, agreement, entitlement, account, dispute, and ledger action is append-only. Use this view to reconstruct why a customer or restaurant state changed.
adminNoCreditAuditEvents: No OxSteed Credit audit events yet.
adminPayoutRecoveryDescription: Use this only when the external payout failed or was returned. The operation requires recovery evidence and creates a compensating ledger entry; it never edits the original payment transaction.
adminTransactionHistoryDescription: Review the full platform movement stream with server-side filters. Amounts are immutable journal movements; open a customer wallet or audit trail for the surrounding context.
adminNoCreditMovements: No Credit movements match these filters.
adminRiskGuardrailsDescription: These server-side caps are enforced in the database transaction. Amounts use the selected overview currency; transfer controls apply only when customer-to-customer transfers are enabled.
adminPurchasesActiveHoldsPerDay: Purchases plus active holds per day
adminFindWalletBeforeAction: Find a wallet before taking action
adminCustomerWalletSearchDescription: Search by customer name, email, UUID, currency, or state. Filters run on the server so the directory remains complete as the customer base grows. Selecting a wallet only fills the controls below; no balance or status changes happen until you submit a form.
adminNoCustomerWalletsMatch: No customer wallets match these filters.
adminGrantAdjustFreezeCredit: Grant, adjust, or freeze OxSteed Credit
adminCustomerControlsDescription: Every grant requires a funding reference. Clawbacks require a reason. Account suspension blocks spend without deleting the customer’s history; closing requires zero balance and no active holds.
adminSharedCustomerFields: The same customer ID and amount fields are shared with the grant form above for consistent operator entry.
adminPartnerLookupDescription: The forms below start with the loaded partner list. Search the server when the partner is not visible, including networks larger than the initial list limit.
adminSearchRestaurantOrId: Search by restaurant name or ID
adminMenuRestrictionDescription: Use menu item IDs to cover only specific items. Leave blank to cover every item in the allowed categories.
adminGeographicCoverageDescription: Leave every field blank for the restaurant's normal service area. If a field is set, a purchase must match one of its comma-separated values.
adminRestrictAssignedCustomersDescriptio: When enabled, only customers with an active entitlement for this agreement can spend here. Leave off for a partner-wide agreement.
adminAgreementCustomerTermsPlaceholder: Plain-language rules the customer will see
adminAgreementReasonPlaceholder: Why is this partner agreement being created?
adminPartnerPickerQuerySummary: Showing {{count}} matching partners in the agreement and settlement selectors.
adminPartnerPickerSummary: Use Find partners to search beyond the initial list. Searching never changes partner status or agreement data.
adminOperationalBoundaryDescription: OxSteed Credit is implemented as restricted stored value. Do not market it as a bank, deposit account, cash equivalent, or money-transmission product without a separate legal/compliance review, custody plan, partner contracts, and any required licensing.
adminAgreementBuilderDescription: Draft the restaurant's rules first. It must be approved and activated before customer checkout can use it.
adminLoadFailed: Unable to load OxSteed Credit administration.
adminCustomerProfileOpenFailed: Unable to open the customer Credit profile.
adminTransactionDetailOpenFailed: Unable to open the Credit transaction detail.
adminChooseCreditPartnerError: Choose a Credit partner before creating an agreement.
adminAgreementCreated: Agreement created for {{partner}} in Draft status.
adminPartnerTransitionDescription: Provide the audit reason for this partner status change.
adminPartnerTransitionReasonRequired: A reason is required for partner status changes.
adminAgreementTransitionTitle: Why are you moving agreement v{{version}} to {{status}}?
adminAgreementTransitionDescription: Provide the audit reason for this agreement status change.
adminAgreementTransitionReasonRequired: A reason is required for agreement status changes.
adminChoosePartnerAgreementError: Choose a partner and agreement before creating a settlement.
adminSettlementSnapshotCreated: Settlement snapshot created in Pending status. Review the totals before approving payment.
adminSettlementTransitionTitle: Why are you moving this settlement to {{status}}?
adminSettlementTransitionDescription: Provide the audit reason for this settlement status change.
adminSettlementTransitionReasonRequired: A reason is required for settlement status changes.
adminExternalPaymentReferenceDescription: A traceable bank, processor, or payout reference is required before marking a non-zero settlement paid.
adminPaymentReferenceRequired: A payment reference is required before a non-zero settlement can be marked paid.
adminSettlementReversalTitle: Why must this paid settlement be reversed?
adminSettlementReversalDescription: Reversal posts a compensating ledger entry and requires recovery evidence.
adminSettlementReversalDefault: External payout returned or failed; restoring payable balance
adminSettlementReversalReasonRequired: A reason is required for settlement reversals.
adminSettlementRecoveryReferenceDescript: Enter the external reference that supports this payout reversal.
adminRecoveryReferenceRequired: A recovery reference is required for settlement reversals.
adminSettlementReversed: Settlement for {{partner}} was reversed and the payable balance restored.
adminReconciliationReasonRequired: A reason is required for reconciliation runs.
adminReconciliationIntegrityFailed: Reconciliation stopped because ledger hash integrity failed. Do not approve a payout until the ledger is investigated.
adminReconciliationDifference: Reconciliation found a difference. Review the run before any payout.
adminCustomerGrantPosted: Customer Credit grant posted to the immutable ledger.
adminCustomerClawbackDescription: This posts an immutable debit of {{amount}} from {{wallet}} and cannot be edited.
adminCustomerClawbackPosted: Customer Credit clawback posted to the immutable ledger.
adminRailReasonRequired: Enter an audit reason before changing the Credit rail status.
adminRailEnabled: OxSteed Credit is enabled for approved activity.
adminRailSuspended: OxSteed Credit is suspended. Existing ledger history remains available for recovery and review.
adminRetryNotificationReasonRequired: Add an audit reason before retrying a Credit notification.
adminNotificationRequeued: Credit notification requeued. The durable worker will retry delivery without changing the ledger.
adminDisputeResolutionRequired: Add a status-change note before updating a Credit dispute.
adminPostedPurchaseOnly: Only a posted Credit purchase can be refunded from this view.
adminRefundAmountRequired: Enter a positive refund amount in {{currency}}.
adminRefundReasonRequired: A reason is required before posting a Credit refund.
adminCreditRefundDescription: This posts a {{amount}} {{currency}} immutable refund movement for this purchase.
adminCreditRefundAlreadyRecorded: The Credit refund request was already recorded; no duplicate movement was posted.
adminCreditRefundPosted: Credit refund posted to the immutable ledger.
adminTransactionCsvDownloaded: Credit transaction CSV downloaded with the active filters.
adminSettlementCsvDownloaded: Settlement CSV downloaded with the active filters.
adminWalletCsvDownloaded: Customer wallet CSV downloaded with the active filters.
adminAuditCsvDownloaded: Credit audit CSV downloaded with the active filters.
adminAuditCsvFailed: Unable to export Credit audit history.
adminDisputeCsvDownloaded: Credit dispute CSV downloaded with the active status filter.
adminReconciliationCsvDownloaded: Credit reconciliation CSV downloaded with the active filters.
adminReconciliationCsvFailed: Unable to export Credit reconciliation history.

cards.title: My Cards
cards.metaDescription: Issue, manage, and secure your OxSteed Credit cards.
cards.pageDescription: Issue a virtual card for instant use, or request a physical card. A card is a way to spend the same balance shown on your OxSteed Credit account -- it never creates a second balance.
cards.secretTitle: One-time card credential -- shown only now
cards.secretDescription: Save this somewhere safe. It cannot be shown again -- if you lose it, report the card lost to get a replacement.
cards.issueDescription: A virtual card is active immediately. A physical card ships to your address and you activate it with a code once it arrives.
cards.noCardsDescription: Issue a virtual card above to start spending your OxSteed Credit balance with a card instead of the wallet screen.
cards.adminDescription: Issue a virtual card instantly, or start a physical card's fulfillment queue, directly for a customer who has not requested one themselves. Every card is only a credential onto that customer's existing Credit account -- no new balance is created here.
cards.adminCredentialDescription: Hand this to the customer now. It cannot be retrieved again -- reporting the card lost and reissuing is the only recovery path.
cards.adminActivationDescription: Print or relay this code to the customer with the physical card. They will enter it once to activate the card after delivery.
cards.activationSecretTitle: One-time activation code -- shown only now

errors.load: Unable to load your OxSteed Credit cards.
errors.shippingAddress: A shipping address is required for a physical card.
errors.activationCode: Enter the activation code printed with your card.
errors.reportLost: Unable to report this card lost.
errors.customerUuid: A customer UUID is required to issue a card.
errors.revokeReason: A reason is required to revoke a card.

success.physicalRequested: Physical card requested. We will notify you once it ships.
success.virtualIssued: Virtual card issued -- ready to use now.
success.activated: Card activated -- it is ready to use.
success.frozen: Card frozen -- it cannot be used until you unfreeze it.
success.lostReplacement: Card reported lost. A replacement card is ready below.
success.pinSaved: PIN saved. Use it at a kiosk to cash out this card.

confirm.reportLost: Report this card lost or stolen? It will be permanently disabled and, unless you cancel, a replacement virtual card will be issued immediately.

adminSuccess.alreadyIssued: This card was already issued for that idempotency key.
adminSuccess.physicalCreated: Physical card created and queued for fulfillment.
adminSuccess.virtualIssued: Virtual card issued and active immediately.

restaurantWallet.title: Restaurant Credit
restaurantWallet.description: Manage restaurant-scoped credit, payments, transfers, and requests.
restaurantWallet.scopeDescription: Each balance belongs to one restaurant. It cannot be spent or transferred at another restaurant.
restaurantWallet.noSelectedDetail: Open a restaurant and choose Manage restaurant credit to request your first balance.
restaurantWallet.reservedMessage: {{amount}} is temporarily reserved for an active payment.
restaurantWallet.sendCredit: Send credit to another OxSteed user
restaurantWallet.noActivityDetail: Approved credit, purchases, transfers, and refunds will appear here.
restaurantWallet.paySubtitle: Show this one-time QR to the restaurant. The reserved amount cannot be spent twice.
restaurantWallet.sendSubtitle: The recipient can only spend this credit at {{restaurant}}.
restaurantWallet.requestSubtitle: Send proof of your payment. {{restaurant}} will add the credit after verifying it.
restaurantWallet.notePlaceholder: Anything that helps verify the payment
restaurantWallet.recipientAndAmount: Enter the recipient email and a valid amount.
restaurantWallet.proofRequired: Upload a receipt or enter a confirmation number.
restaurantWallet.requestSent: Credit request sent to the restaurant.
restaurantWallet.refreshFailed: The wallet view could not be refreshed.
restaurantWallet.walletsLoadFailed: Unable to load your restaurant wallets.
restaurantWallet.createQrFailed: Unable to create the payment QR.
restaurantWallet.cancelQrFailed: Unable to cancel the payment QR.
restaurantWallet.submitFailed: Unable to submit the credit request.
